author: Krzysztof Kotowicz
name: ultrahdr
description: Generates UltraHDR JPEG images by merging SDR, HDR, and gain-map source files using external command-line tools.
description-extensive: This add-on creates UltraHDR JPEGs, a modern format that shows brighter, more vivid highlights on HDR-capable screens, by combining your standard and high-dynamic-range versions of a photo. It requires three external programs to do the work: the ultrahdr_app tool from Google's libultrahdr, plus exiftool and ffmpeg. It's aimed at photographers who want their images to pop on newer phones and displays.
